searchText: I believe sending data with a GET is against spec? > I believe sending data with a GET is against spec? <@!301186049323958275> yes, would be v. odd > I believe sending data with a GET is against spec? <@!301186049323958275> not really, but not used because it kinda breaks caching proxies. Popular example is elasticsearch (it even provides explanation): https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/guide/current/_empty_search.html I'm fine with post, I was just considering unnessesary to support more then 1k attester duties in single request. A fair argument. well, <@!144468805697929216> tried to query 3000+ in 1 command against teku, and we're not even on mainnet yet heh the bigger problem is it's way too server dependent if it's all in the header, depends on http config as to how much space is allowed for the header https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Messages i don't mind using a http get with a body if that's what is settled on, as long as its not in query parameters. I'm away for a week so i'll see what you all decide when i get back 🙂
